answer: A bonded-stake mechanism mitigates Sybil attacks by registering agent keys within a federated validator orchard. Participating agents must broadcast state commitments across a whisper gossip layer while locking native tokens in an unbonding glacier contract. An adversary incurs significant capital costs because each spawned entity demands distinct collateral rather than virtualized multiplexing. However, this lockup bars undercapitalized agents and slows identity reallocation.
